name: Runtime: absent hit default permission-only update is rejected
setup: $TC p4template create action/ptables/test actid 1 param param1 type bit32
$TC p4template update action/ptables/test num_prealloc_acts 16 state active
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname tblid 1 keysz 16 table_acts act name ptables/test act name NoAction
cmdUnderTest: $TC p4ctrl update ptables/table/cb/tname tbl_attrs default_hit_action permissions 0x1424

name: Runtime: absent miss default permission-only update is rejected
setup: $TC p4template create action/ptables/test actid 1 param param1 type bit32
$TC p4template update action/ptables/test num_prealloc_acts 16 state active
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname tblid 1 keysz 16 table_acts act name ptables/test act name NoAction
cmdUnderTest: $TC p4ctrl update ptables/table/cb/tname tbl_attrs default_miss_action permissions 0x1424

name: Runtime: mixed update with absent miss is rejected without changing hit
setup: $TC p4template create action/ptables/test actid 1 param param1 type bit32
$TC p4template update action/ptables/test num_prealloc_acts 16 state active
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname tblid 1 keysz 16 table_acts act name ptables/test act name NoAction default_hit_action action ptables/test param param1 7 index 17
cmdUnderTest: $TC p4ctrl update ptables/table/cb/tname tbl_attrs default_hit_action permissions 0x1424 default_miss_action permissions 0x1c24
